resources.string: Connect Spotify to bring your playlists into LFly; your Liked Songs become your Favourites. Songs are played by LFly, not by Spotify. You sign in on Spotify\'s own page: your password never passes through LFly.
Sign in with your Spotify account. As soon as you are in, LFly connects on its own.
Bring all your playlists into LFly
Playlists already imported stay in LFly.

Shows what you listen to on your Discord profile. Discord has no official way for an app to do this: LFly uses your session as the Discord app would, which Discord does not allow. Use at your own risk.
Show what you listen to on your profile
Sign-in failed: tap to try again
Sign in with your Discord account. As soon as you are in, LFly connects on its own.
The song, the artist and the time left; gone while paused
As Spotify, Discord shows Spotify\'s green card.
LFly already uses its own Discord application to show covers and its icon. To use one of yours, paste its Application ID here; leave it empty to go back to LFly\'s.
The status leaves your profile and LFly forgets the sign-in.

Favourites, playlists and history changed on one device reach the other. On the same Wi-Fi network the same YouTube Music account on phone and computer is all it takes. Google Drive keeps them in sync from afar too, and needs a one-time setup (see the README of LFly for computer).
Google did not grant access to Drive
On: syncs while LFly is open on the computer, with the same account
